user_query: I'm redecorating my house and want to add some adorable kitten images to my gallery wall. Can you provide me with random kitten pictures and suggest some online art stores where I can purchase cat-themed artwork? It would be great if you could also share some interesting facts about cats to include in the description of the artwork.

TaskList.description: Fetch random kitten images from an image API.
Search for online art stores that sell cat-themed artwork.
Retrieve interesting facts about cats from a facts API.
